neu.name: Claude Platform Release Notes
zeilen: * Text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on the platforms listed in [How Claude marks AI-generated content](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content). On Claude Sonnet 4.6, text generated for a request that sets `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` to a non-default value might not carry it. See [Text watermark](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/text-watermark).
